games.name: It Takes One To Gnome It All
Battle Runes of Metalaria
games.summary: Is the next card going to be higher or lower? Do you have what it takes to beat the odds?See if you can beat your best score or your friends. Great at parties or if you have a few minutes and want to pass the time.Get stuck in to the best Higher or Lower game going!

games.name: Dub Party
games.summary: A dubbing party game for you and your friends. Import a video clip, claim the roles and record every line in the booth, then watch the finished dub together and save it. Play solo, pass one mic around on the couch, or invite up to 7 friends online.

games.name: skl survivor
games.summary: score attack game where you move forward and shoot continuously and must rotate change direction

games.name: Another Card Game
games.summary: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

games.name: Armed Prisoner III
games.summary: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration

games.name: Brick Buddies (Bunnyhop)
games.summary: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

games.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan's Deal
games.summary: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.

games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.summary: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

games.name: Defend The HexCore
games.summary: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

games.name: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey
games.summary: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

games.name: GymPup
games.summary: GymPup is a BL furry romance narrative game that combines idle desktop gameplay with visual novel elements. Accompany the protagonist and witness his transformation—both physical and emotional.

games.name: Kaidanji
games.summary: 山の中にてあなたは偶然にも、怪談寺に迷い込む――。そこにいたのは、正体不明の奇妙な4人の人物だった。聞かされる怪談話の数々。王道ホラーから人怖、SFホラー、ホラーコメディなど多岐に渡る怖い話を楽しめます。VHS風画面短編集ホラーノベルゲーム。

games.name: Leviticus
games.summary: Leviticus is a dark sci-fi action game where you play as an angel sent to guard those made in his image. Tasked with defending humanity, you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders, beings that were never made in the image of God. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.

games.name: Meow Field
games.summary: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.

games.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!
games.summary: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.

games.name: Necrogen
games.summary: Defend a forest watchtower against waves of monsters in a first-person survival shooter. Earn cash from kills, buy weapons and upgrades, fight flying gargoyles, and face bosses in dedicated arenas. Spend your last dollars on ammo or repairs? The next round will test your choice.

games.name: PICK A BOO
games.summary: PICK A BOO is an online co-op action game where you use magnetic powers to stick furniture together and haul it out.

Rubber Stamp Legend
games.summary: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless "business expenses," outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

games.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor
games.summary: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.

games.name: Veltarum
games.summary: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

games.name: ZJ the Ball
games.summary: Breakthrough Gaming creates Christian themed entertainment products such as video games, animation, comics, and books.

games.name: 100 Views of Japan's Four Seasons
games.summary: Explore the beauty of Japan through relaxing scenic puzzles, spot-the-difference challenges, quizzes, and more across all 47 prefectures.

games.name: A Needle In a Haystack
games.summary: Search a persistent hay pile with 4,000,000 candidates and one winning needle. Work strand by strand alone or with up to three friends, sort the mess, sell strange finds, and unlock better tools in a cozy first-person test of patience.

games.name: a strange journey into the backrooms
Abracademia
games.summary: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

games.name: Against Heroes
games.summary: Why wait for heroes to come for you? Build and deploy a monster army to eliminate them before they grow strong enough to defeat you. A strategy roguelite from the Demon Lord’s perspective!

games.name: ART NOIRE: Paris
games.summary: ART NOIRE: Paris is an atmospheric ring-based puzzle game that combines classic film noir aesthetics with the romantic elegance of 1960s Paris. Rotate concentric rings, align the details, and restore beautiful illustrations.

games.name: Autistic Romance
games.summary: What makes divorce a justified decision? Does it even need to be justified? Each night, choose who to spend your time with. Decide what you believe about relationships at 'The End' of this visual novel.

games.name: Avalon: Legacy Edition
games.summary: Explore the distant world of Avalon, battle dangerous creatures and uncover its secrets in a faithful recreation of the 1998 DOS RPG by its original creators. A classic 2D adventure reborn for modern systems.

games.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic
games.summary: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.

games.name: Billionth Soul
games.summary: Grow humanity’s last colony from one thawed sleeper to one billion souls aboard a failing generation ship. Draft cards, build powerful grid combinations, and trade population against dwindling life support in this idle roguelite deckbuilder. The billionth soul is the hardest one to save.

games.name: BlockBabe
games.summary: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.

games.name: Boris & the Second Sun
games.summary: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.

games.name: Bouncemetry
games.summary: Bouncemetry is a physics-based incremental game focused on geometric simulations. Unlock different scenarios, such as bouncing mechanics, glass shattering, and color filling, and run them simultaneously. Generate passive income and infinitely scale your simulation parameters through a skill tree.

games.name: BULWARK: Hold the Heart
games.summary: Build an economy, train an army and hold a living swarm back from your colony's Heart. Real-time strategy as wave defence, with the controls RTS players know: control groups, grid hotkeys, shift-queued orders. A 25-level campaign, three heroes, a 121-node War Council tree and an endless mode.

games.name: Cannon War
games.summary: Cannon War is a pixel-art tower-defense strategy game spanning Ancient, Modern, and Future Warfare. Build towers and barricades to reshape enemy routes, combine weapons and targeting strategies, expand your permanent arsenal, and defend your headquarters through a multi-era campaign.

games.name: Climb Together
games.summary: Play solo or stuck with up to 100 friends, explore various worlds and overcome obstacles together. Unlock abilities and checkpoints that aid your journey to uncover the truth and reach the peak in this challenging 3D co-op platformer!

games.name: Corposlop
games.summary: Coloring Book with all wins club characters.. Have fun with your kids.

games.name: Dear My Son
games.summary: Raise a family, carry on through generations, and fight demons to break a curse passed down through your bloodline in this family legacy simulation game.

games.name: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
Farmstead Market Simulator
games.summary: Build and grow your own farm and roadside market. Grow crops, raise animals, craft valuable products, set prices, hire employees, stock your shelves, serve customers, and expand your small operation into a thriving business.

games.name: For The King II: Dust to Dust Character Pack
Forbidden House
games.summary: Forbidden House is a first-person puzzle adventure with over 40 puzzles to solve.

games.name: Game About Botting in an MMORPG Demo
Go Next!
games.summary: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

games.name: Golden Pan
games.summary: A cozy gold panning game. Wash the creek gravel, watch the gold settle in your pan, sell your finds in the village, and turn a small empty room into a home. No timers, no failure. Just quiet, golden little days.

games.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator
games.summary: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.

games.name: Gotching
games.summary: Raise a creature with a brain of its own: seventeen instincts, senses that mutate between runs, and a memory that lasts its whole life. Play it by hand to teach it, or watch it descend alone. Every floor is built from scratch, nothing comes identified, and it never truly dies.

games.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
games.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

games.name: Hotdog Killer
games.summary: Fun Foxy Top Gear Challenge - Free Street Surfing Endurance Race is an exciting fast pasted game. Remember Street Surfing in the Michael J. Fox movie Teen Wolf? Control Fun Foxy the Fox as he Street Surfs on a variety of crazy cars like the Delorean from Back to the Future, The Flintstones car, and the Ghostbusters Ambulance. Turbocharge Foxy in a rallycross style race to the north.

games.name: Hunter Bro VR
games.summary: Bow-hunt big game across five wild grounds in VR. Draw a real bow, track and call trophy animals, and survive the night when the woods hunt you back. Play it like a hunting sim, or open the cheats and bring a rocket launcher to a deer hunt. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 friends.

games.name: Idle Camp Tale
games.summary: Camp & Conquer is a fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

games.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.

games.name: Kreabordis
games.summary: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.

games.name: Law Firm Simulator
games.summary: Law Firm Simulator is a business management sandbox where you build and run your own legal empire. Hire lawyers, take on clients, manage complex cases, expand your offices, and grow a small practice into the city’s most prestigious law firm.

games.name: LeechWire 2003
games.summary: It's 2003. Your modem screams, pop-ups multiply, and your shared folder is your empire. Leech files, seed them for credits, close fake virus alerts before they eat your bandwidth, and keep your LeechMessenger friends happy in this Y2K idle game.

games.name: Lightkeeper: Frozen Bay
games.summary: You are the keeper of a lighthouse on a frozen northern island. Keep the lamp lit, the stove fed and the car fueled. And when the storm comes, don't step out where the light can't reach: a wendigo walks the island at night. And it is listening.

games.name: Little Lands
games.summary: Build your world, one hex at a time. Little Lands is a peaceful, low-stress world builder where you gather resources, expand your landscape, and create a world of your own. No timers, no game overs, just build, decorate, and enjoy.

games.name: Lost Crystal Adventure
games.summary: When mysterious changes begin to affect the kingdom, the king summons a young adventurer to Xenopolis and entrusts them with a quest that could decide the realm’s fate. Journey through dangerous lands and uncover the secrets surrounding the crystal. What awaits you on the road ahead?

games.name: Magua: Twenty Sorrows
games.summary: An autobattler focused on the creating synergies to buff your team. Upgrade your units and defeat increasingly stronger enemies in this rogue-like game.

games.name: March and Conquer
games.summary: Kawaii Find is a super cute fast-paced object search game. You have just 60 seconds to find as many objects as you can to obtain a high score!Once the kawaii images are randomly placed on the board, you must find all of the specified item on each page as they refresh until your 60 seconds are up! Features:- Game Center Leaderboards Integration- Super kawaii hand drawn images- Fast-paced addictive play style!**Be sure to "like" Last Haven Games on Facebook for news and details on future updates! http://www.facebook.com/lasthavengames

games.name: Masyu: Line Logic
games.summary: A relaxing logic puzzle where you draw one loop through every circle, going straight through the white ones and turning on the black ones. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 15,000 more, Easy to Expert.

games.name: Mazehold
games.summary: Build the maze. Hold the keep. A tower defense roguelite without waves: survive one relentless 20-minute siege, turn every tower into part of your maze, discover 21 tower combos, draft cards as you level up and face four demon bosses.

games.name: Megachest
games.summary: Megachest is an incremental game about opening chests, discovering legendary loot, and building your ultimate fortune empire! Start with simple rewards and grow into a master of magic and riches as you unlock rare items, upgrade your power, and hire helpers to automate your chest-opening journey

games.name: Menthal
games.summary: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

games.name: Mini Battleships
games.summary: Start with a tiny boat and a single gun. Sink ships, salvage their gold and turn your vessel into a gloriously over-armed floating fortress. A calm, minimalist naval roguelike with an ever-changing soundtrack, where the sea always wins in the end, but never before you look magnificent.

games.name: Mini Mart Survivors
games.summary: SHIFT24 is no ordinary convenience store chain. Strange customers swarm in endlessly, and ramen, snacks, coffee, anything on the shelf is a weapon. Fend them off, chase the clues worldwide, and pay your debt to uncover SHIFT24's truth.

games.name: Neon One-Man Army
games.summary: High-speed, neon-infused single-player action! Swing through platforms with your grappling gun, blast rogue robots, and stay airborne to survive. Choose powerful cards at every level, unlock skill chests, and master the ultimate momentum-based power fantasy.

games.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
games.summary: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

games.name: Palisade
games.summary: Draw borders, build roads and strongholds, and conquer rival realms in a fast single-player strategy game fought across sixteen historically grounded scenarios. Command five campaigns, custom Skirmishes, and a shared Daily Chronicle.

games.name: Path to Catakombs
games.summary: Build and defend an armored train through ever-changing underground routes. Recruit gunners, alchemists, and mechanics, upgrade your wagons, choose your path, and survive relentless kobold raids and colossal bosses.

games.name: PeeVPee
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

games.name: Picronix 2
games.summary:
Take a breather and challenge your brain with these calming logic puzzles

Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Solve the number clues to reveal hidden pixel art pictures. Solving each row and column brings you closer to the final image. Enjoy the perfect blend of calm and challenge. A lot unique puzzles await you. They're perfect for a quick break or a long session. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

games.name: Plum
games.summary: Plum is a 3d cozy platforming and collectathon game where you will have to roll and bounce through the valley in search for home. On your way, meet different ghost plums each which a story to share. This game is a colorful stylized short adventure (about 1h) made to chill or speedrunning.

games.name: Progress98
games.summary: A retro incremental idle desktop companion all about making progress on the side and at your own pace.

games.name: REC:REWIND
games.summary: Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him. Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

games.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas
games.summary: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas is a cozy first-person present sorting game where you help Santa and his elves sort 2,352 presents! With each present you sort, you get one step closer to unlocking Santa's gifts, which will help you sort even faster. Are you willing to help Santa this year?

games.name: Score Circuit
games.summary: Chain risky scoring nodes, cash out before the circuit burns out, and unlock 30 modifiers that bend every run. Score Circuit is a compact neon score-attack roguelite about one more carefully calculated push.

games.name: Scrapline (Tenth Studio)
games.summary: Scrapline is a third-person wave-survival roguelite shooter. Rogue robots fill a live-fire range, and you have one gun. Pick a weapon aspect: Bounce, Turrets, Burn or Blast. Spend salvage, pick one of 20 characters with real trade-offs, survive 20 waves, then chase your Endless record.

games.name: Shademarch
games.summary: An async PvP autobattler. Build four heroes from 21 classes, draft the skills and items that change how they fight, then watch them battle other players' teams. Progress through the March, or climb the ranks on an even playing field in the Arena.

games.name: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder
games.summary: Build the robot. Design the tactics with Thought Tiles. Then just watch. Assemble the 18cm-tall autonomous hobby robot “SIGNOS” and program its behavior logic with flowchart-style “Thought Tiles.” No controls during battle — SIGNOS fights on its own, guided solely by the logic you designed.

games.name: Sword of the Last Second
games.summary: You have been bestowed the 'Sword of the Demiurge' and the authority to sever the bonds of soul and flesh. Make haste for your appointed time has arrived. Defeat your foes, collect their souls, and manifest your authority, until the myriads fall before you in a single moment.

games.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer
games.summary: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.

games.name: Terrified Gorillas
games.summary: A co-op VR horror game. You're a gorilla trapped in Primal Dynamics' abandoned test facilities, and the monsters know you're here. Climb, run and hide through mazes, sewers and the backrooms with your friends, or become the monster in Monster Hunt.

games.name: The Big Suck
games.summary: A short incremental game where you are the disaster. Destroy fields, cars, buildings. Gather wreck to grow and spend it on upgrades inside the big skill tree.

games.name: The Great Sassanelli - An Interactive Novel
The Guiding Light - Five-Class Cosmetic Pack
The Inspector
games.summary: a Train has been infected with mysterious anomalies. G.O.A.B has secretly hired you to inspect the train. It's your job to find the anomalies and terminate them.

games.name: The Staring Man
games.summary: A first-person horror game set in a Japanese convenience store. You work the night shift alone. Across the street, a man stands staring at you every night. As you encounter inexplicable events, you investigate the mystery of a former employee who disappeared.

games.name: Tidy Up Mall
games.summary: Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 4,990 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

games.name: Tiny Village (Elpoco)
games.summary: Tiny Village is an incremental game where you gather resources and use them to develop your village. Collect resources, unlock upgrades, and gradually grow your small village!

games.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror
Towers of Babble
games.summary: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together, we must beat them all and talk our way back into heaven.

games.name: Tube2K
games.summary: Build the video sharing platform that will change the world. Will you bring about the Golden Age of humanity or bring it to its knees?

games.name: Twin-stick Japanese
games.summary: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

games.name: UFO98
games.summary: Defy the government, leak top-secret alien telemetry, and wake up the world… inside an isolated Win98 workstation.

games.name: Vestalborne
games.summary: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is a co-op action-RPG sandbox of fast combat, deep dungeons, and endless crafting across many dimensions. Keep the Eternal Flame burning in a solo adventure, with friends, or against them.

games.name: Vida:Unslain
games.summary: Vida: Unslain is a dungeon exploration game where players explore labyrinths, battle enemies, choose their path, and progress through each dungeon.

games.name: What the Buck?!
games.summary: What the Buck?! is an incremental game about destroying money. Smash stacks of cash, upgrade your destructive power, automate your money withdrawals, declare bankruptcy and watch the numbers explode.

games.name: What the Puck?!
games.summary: Arcade Ice Hockey gets out of hand. Dodge UFOs, survive a tilting rink and score with every puck in play. Compete solo, with up to four players in local split screen, or with up to six online. Pick your events, boost past trouble and rescue your frozen teammates to score the winning slapshot!

games.name: Worst Class Ever
games.summary: This is a fun 1-6 player asymmetric party game! Five player are mischievous troublemakers，hide among dozens of NPC students to sneak snacks, pass secret notes, and use phones secretly in class. One player acts as a strict teacher, track down all hidden troublemakers in the crowd.

games.name: Your account has been banned
games.summary: This is a surreal and hilarious choice-based dialogue game. You’ve signed up for the latest AI assistant, but its decision-making algorithm clearly has some issues—it’s currently banning users left and right.

games.name: Your Suffering Is Important to Us
games.summary: Run a corporate office in Hell. Hire and customize, and assign imployees, reject petty sinners, automate absurd punishments, and climb the infernal corporate ladder in this comedic incremental management game.

games.name: ZOLGE STATION: HUGA Waiwai Academy
games.summary: The disk magazine is back. A whole-school software magazine from indie studio HU-GA. Free issue 00 holds a trial of the pixel-art driving game DAWN CAR with an ending found only here, plus the creator's audio commentary, and episode 01 of the talk show Zolge Station. New issues arrive as DLC.

games.name: 游戏发行模拟器 Game Launch Simulator
A Quiet Place Between Us
games.summary:
A beautiful romance visual novel where love blossoms gently before drifting toward heartbreak. 

Guide Hina and Kenta through a warm yet fragile relationship shaped by outside pressure, hidden motives, and painful choices leading to emotional multiple endings.

games.name: After the Wane
games.summary:
The new interactive graphic novel by the creators of Along the Edge and Across the Grooves.

Lena is a starry-eyed young dancer with big dreams, but as soon as she sets foot in the capital, she finds herself at the nexus of a lifelong quarrel between Fernand, the elusive director of a community center, and Deborah, who's leading the troupe of a strange and exclusive theatre. Does it have anything to do with her mother, a dancer too, who abandoned her when she was a child?

Torn between her past and her future, Lena will need to rediscover her own nature and forge her path forward as increasingly strange events unfold around her... but the strangest of all might be the permanent commentary of a voice that she seems to be the only one to hear.

games.name: Akuro and Bahaku VS Pollution Monsters
Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
Clay Crusade: Night of the Necromancer
Cozy Marbles - Jelle's Marble Runs Supporter Pack
Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin
Ghost Receipt - A Cyberpunk Pawnshop Simulator
Hidden Bananas
games.summary: Find hidden bananas across tropical islands! Relaxing point-and-click gameplay with beautiful ocean views and soothing music. Can you spot them all?

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary:
Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. 

But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. 

Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken.

games.name: Horde Highway: Zombie Survivors on Wheels
MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge.

Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt.

games.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished
games.summary: Turn pain into power with The Punished, a new clan joining the fight in Monster Train 2! Led by Archus, Darkness Incarnate, The Punished introduce a new risk-reward play style built around damaging your own units, harnessing their suffering, and turning it against your enemies.

games.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space
Nocturnal 2
games.summary: Nocturnal 2 is an atmospheric action adventure game in which you play as Ardeshir, bearer of the Enduring Flame, who sets out to explore the dark depths and towering heights of the forgotten city of Ytash in order to break the curse that has consumed his homeland.

games.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist Soundtrack
Potion-Making: Path of the Alchemist Supporter Pack
Project Motor Racing: World Endurance Pack
Safe Zone: A Cozy Post-Apocalyptic Game Demo

Fakin' It XL
games.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary:
17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.

Hope in the City is a narrative mystery game, set in the Chinese city of Shenyang, by the team behind the 2026 GDC Best in Play Winner Sky of Tides and the Annie Award-nominated Eternal Spring. Play as Hope, a 17-year-old girl investigating her parents' disappearance, connecting the clues and uncovering the truth hidden beneath the city's calm.

NO NOTE NO WARNING
You come home from school like any other day. But the house is too quiet. Your parents are gone, the apartment is in shambles. No note, no warning, no answer. Hope Song is 17, and she's just become the only person willing to ask what really happened.

AN ARTIST’S EYE
Hope isn't a detective. She's an artist. And that's exactly what makes her dangerous to whoever's hiding the truth. Every room holds details that don't add up: a shadow in the wrong place, an object that shouldn't be there, a lie in someone's eyes.

Capture what you see as sketches in Hope's notebook. Every detail matters.

FROM OBSERVATION TO TRUTH
Connect what you've seen into insights, and push those insights until they crack open into breakthroughs. Piece by piece, sketch by sketch, the picture of what happened to your parents starts to take shape, and it's darker than you imagined.

A CITY FULL OF SECRETS
Shenyang isn't just a backdrop, it's a character of its own. Rendered in a bold, stylized art style with an edge, every street, storefront, and shadowed alley is begging to be explored. Wander past neon signs and quiet corners alike, and let the city's striking visuals pull you deeper into its secrets.

WHO CAN YOU TRUST?
On the surface, it's just home: familiar streets, quiet neighbors, ordinary life. But beneath Hope's peaceful existence, secrets are buried. And now it's her time to find the truth.
